title: Betting Policy
description: The thresholds and caps a project's wagering decisions are judged against. Separate from project-policy.yml on purpose: that file says which RULES apply to this project, this one says what the NUMBERS are. Mixing them would put a bankroll figure and a rule waiver in the same document, and they are reviewed by different people for different reasons. Every value is written as a string and constrained by pattern, because the YAML parser this repository uses returns all scalars as strings so that a pattern can be checked before anything coerces; scripts/policy.mjs performs the single conversion to number. Each decision record pins the digest of the policy it was decided under, so changing a threshold here never retroactively re-judges past decisions.

minEdge.description: The smallest edge, AFTER the uncertainty discount, that may support a BET. Anything at or above passes the gate; anything below is a PASS. This is the number that keeps a thin, uncertain edge from becoming a wager, and it should exceed what transaction costs and estimation error consume — an edge smaller than your own error bar is noise (Standard 10 R1).

kellyMultiplier.description: The fraction of full Kelly to stake, in (0, 1]. Full Kelly is optimal only if the probability estimate is exactly right; it is an estimate, so fractional Kelly is the standard response to being wrong. Values around 0.25 are common (Standard 12 R2).

unitPercent.description: One unit as a fraction of bankroll, e.g. 0.01 for 1%. The unit exists so stakes can be discussed without reference to a bankroll figure (Standard 12 R1).

maxSingleBetPct.description: The hard ceiling on any one stake as a fraction of bankroll, applied even when Kelly recommends more. Kelly optimises growth under a correct estimate; this bounds the damage from an incorrect one (Standard 13 R1).

maxGroupExposurePct.description: The ceiling on total stake within one correlation group. Correlated wagers are one wager wearing several tickets, and this is the cap that says so (Standard 14 R2).

maxTotalExposurePct.description: The ceiling on all open stake at once, as a fraction of bankroll (Standard 13 R2).

maxOddsAgeMinutes.description: How old a price snapshot may be when a decision is recorded. Beyond this the price is a memory rather than an offer, and an edge computed against it is an edge against a number that may no longer exist (Standard 15, Standard 16 R1).

maxPredictionAgeMinutes.description: How old the probability estimate may be when a decision is recorded. A prediction has a shelf life: news, lineups, and weather all expire it (Standard 16 R1).

longshotOddsThreshold.description: Decimal odds at or above which the longshot floor applies. The proportional vig-removal method this pack uses overstates the fair probability of long prices, because books load more margin onto them; rather than hide that, the method's known bias gets a mechanical guard (Standard 9 R5).

longshotMinDiscount.description: The minimum uncertainty discount required when the price is at or above longshotOddsThreshold.

note.description: Free text: why these numbers, and when they were last reviewed.
